description: This file is a PHP source file for the vtiger CRM system, specifically implementing the 'ShowHistory' functionality for user login history. It fetches login history data for a user, handles pagination, and renders the output via a Smarty template.

classes.name: LoginHistory
classes.description: A class that manages the retrieval of user login history entries for display.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine subclass used for rendering the web page.

methods.name: getHistoryListViewHeader
methods.description: Returns the headers for the login history list view.

methods.name: getHistoryListViewEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the login history entries for display, given a username and pagination info.
